text:
With merit and the fruits of virtue, and with affection, please perform the rite of the beloved one now.  
Arise from the earth-bed, O you who are adorned with fresh, tender blossoms, and go to the forest.  
There, where the minds of the petty, deluded by lack of discernment, are always agitated by the clamor of wealth, disease, and change, even the name [of the divine] is not heard.
